findings.description: Required-evidence gap: the candidate contains no diff. Base and head commits are identical and the review-diff artifact is empty (its hash is the SHA-256 of zero bytes). The custody-contract acceptance criterion requires a bounded local implementation/test packet specifying exact source, role commitment and payout encoding, public-state disclosure, secret custody/recovery, one-shot initialization, action/revision binding, entry-balance semantics, complete financial comparisons and all rejection controls. None of these can be evaluated because no packet, source, or test content is present. Either the bundle was assembled from the wrong range or the candidate has not yet been authored.

findings.description: Consistency note, not a defect: the contract's entry-balance semantics and its prohibition on ownPublicKey-based authorization are corroborated by the supplied standard-library comment ('the balance returned is the balance of the contract at the start of the current execution') and by the unshielded-token tutorial extract (lines 170-230). A future packet must honor both; this cannot be checked against an empty diff.

The source-extracts artifact contains nine heavily overlapping windows of the same standard-library region. This wastes artifact budget and adds no independent evidence. Not material to the verdict, but the bundler should deduplicate extracts in the resubmission.
